assessment.AOTA_must_write_parent_DB: Only if automatic parent-session message visibility is chosen; current AOTA code does not do so
assessment.desktop_reload_needed: yes to see persisted messages after reconnect/session resume; no evidence of direct missed-event replay
assessment.UI_notification_without_LLM_resume: possible in an adapter boundary, but current Desktop integration is not proven
assessment.live_task_main_model_resume: not proven for AOTA and not implied by notify_on_complete metadata

boundary_rule: UI notification, session message append, and automatic model resume are separate capabilities; evidence supports none of the latter two for the current AOTA-to-Desktop path.
